name: cadpal
description: Peter A. Lilley — resume site (Vite + React + Express)

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @cadpal/api" "npm run dev -w @cadpal/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cadpal/web && npm run build -w @cadpal/api
scripts.build:pages: npm run resume:pdf && npm run build -w @cadpal/web
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n api,web,tunnel -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @cadpal/api" "npm run dev -w @cadpal/web" "node scripts/start-tunnel.mjs"
